_comment: Performance budgets, in bytes. These are the numbers the site shipped at, rounded up with a little headroom. If a change pushes past one, that is the signal to optimise rather than to raise the number — and if you do raise it, say why in the PR.
criticalPathNote: HTML + stylesheet + preloaded fonts + the LCP image on the home page, uncompressed.
firstLoadScriptNote: Only js/site.js runs on every page. chat.js, comments.js, post.js, lang.js and blogs.js are all loaded on demand.
maxImageNote: img/social-card.jpg is the largest; it is never fetched by a browser, only by link unfurlers.
allowedDeferredThirdPartyNote: MathJax, on maths posts only, and it must stay async.
